definition: an energetic attempt to achieve something
description: A bearded man in a bright orange jacket and a grey beanie stands on a grassy clifftop above a grey, white-capped sea. The wind rips his scarf out sideways and flattens the grass; he grabs at his hat to stop it flying off, turns his back to the gust, then bends forward and pushes himself uphill step by step, bracing his hands on his knees as the wind shoves him back.

en.question: What is the man struggling against?

de.answer: Er kämpft gegen den starken Wind an.
de.question: Wogegen kämpft der Mann an?

es.answer: Está luchando contra el fuerte viento.
es.question: ¿Contra qué está luchando el hombre?

fr.answer: Il lutte contre le vent violent.
phrases: tenir fermement son bonnet de laine
fr.question: Contre quoi l'homme lutte-t-il ?
